name: 守墓的侦察者
desc: 反转：从自己卡组把1只攻击力1500以下的名字带有「守墓」的怪兽特殊召唤。
faq: You can select a Gravekeeper whose ATK would be higher than 1500 after being Summoned. For example, if "Necrovalley" is in play, you can use "Gravekeeper’s Spy" to Special Summon another "Gravekeeper’s Spy", even though its ATK will be 1700 once it is on the field.
